title: Full-round AES-128 biclique key recovery, 2011 proceedings version

target.description: Standard full 10-round AES-128 with its real key schedule and standard final round.

setting.key_relation: The biclique uses internal related-key computations; the attacker is not given related-key secret-key oracles.
assumptions: Single target secret key and chosen-ciphertext decryption access.
Sufficient data for the source biclique construction; theoretical computation estimate.

time.note: Table 1 reports computations/success rate; Section 6.4 estimates AES-equivalent work including key scheduling. Source recomputation counts disagree: Table3=56, Section6.3=57, Section6.4=55 S-boxes; reported headline retained.

data.note: Section6.2 fixes four ciphertext bytes and one further byte equality, so the ciphertext codebook budget does not exceed2^88 blocks. This is not a chosen-plaintext label.

memory.note: Section 6.4 counts complete g computations including intermediate states and subkeys, not 128-bit blocks or bytes.

preprocessing.note: Biclique construction2^7 and matching precomputation2^7 occur per key group and are included in Section6.4 total time. No separately reusable offline setup budget is reported.

success.description: Section 6.4 states success probability one for the complete key-space search.
